preheader: Jensen Huang reinstated at Nvidia, Amazon buys Decart for $7.5B, and Alcaraz wins ATP Finals.

lead.headline: Jensen Huang Reinstated as Nvidia CEO
lead.body: Nvidia's board of directors unanimously voted to bring back co-founder Jensen Huang as CEO and president. The decision followed input from U.S. officials confirming his return poses no national security risk, driving a sharp market rally.
lead.why: Understanding how rapidly executive governance decisions impact enterprise valuation is essential for your financial analysis and management courses at Merage.

stories.headline: Amazon buys AI startup Decart for $7.5 billion
stories.body: Amazon is acquiring Israeli AI startup Decart's optimization technology and research team in a reported $7.5 billion deal. The purchase comes as Amazon prepares to launch its proprietary Trainium chips.
stories.why: This deal provides a real-world example of how major cloud providers acquire specialized AI software teams to support proprietary hardware lines.

stories.headline: Disney+ to fully integrate Hulu in December
stories.body: Disney CEO Josh D'Amaro announced that Disney+ will fully combine Hulu into a single unified app starting December 2026 for subscribers.
stories.why: Useful for analyzing corporate strategy and subscriber retention tactics in your marketing classes.

stories.headline: Tesla reveals FSD v15 maxes out AI4 computer chips
stories.body: Elon Musk explained that Tesla's Full Self-Driving v15 software utilizes almost all available processing compute on current AI4 vehicle hardware. Future AI5 chips will go to Optimus humanoid robots first.
stories.why: Illustrates how hardware constraints dictate product roadmaps in autonomous technology companies.

stories.headline: U.S. intelligence chief warns of AI upgrade outages
stories.body: Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton warned that updating legacy digital infrastructure for AI integration will trigger more tech outages across federal agencies and corporations.
stories.why: Highlights the operational risks enterprise clients face when executing massive IT overhauls.

stories.headline: BCG report outlines $100B export strategy for Indian textiles
stories.body: A joint study by Boston Consulting Group and CII indicates India must grow textile exports by over 20% annually to reach $100 billion by FY31, identifying automation and capacity expansion as top priorities.
stories.why: A clear demonstration of how management consultancies build market entry and growth strategies for national sector initiatives.

stories.headline: LinkedIn CEO shares networking strategy for Gen Z
stories.body: LinkedIn CEO Daniel Shapero advised student job seekers to combat AI-driven hiring hurdles by reaching out directly to current employees at target firms.
stories.why: Direct advice for your upcoming internship search and alumni outreach efforts at UCI.

stories.headline: UC Irvine men's basketball falls 72-68 to LMU
stories.body: The Anteaters narrowed a late seven-point deficit down to one point twice, but Loyola Marymount converted six late free throws to close out the win in Palm Desert.

stories.headline: Carlos Alcaraz claims first ATP Finals title over Zverev
stories.body: Carlos Alcaraz defeated Alexander Zverev 6-2, 7-6 to win the ATP Finals in Turin, becoming the fourth male player in history to win all four Grand Slams and the season-ending championship.

term.name: Corporate Governance
term.definition: The system of rules, practices, and processes by which a firm is directed and controlled by its board of directors. In today's news, Nvidia's board exercised its ultimate authority by unanimously reinstating CEO Jensen Huang after consulting U.S. officials.

serve.headline: coprod raised $6M to simplify robot hardware prototyping
serve.body: Swiss robotics startup coprod secured a $6 million pre-seed funding round. The company is building a dedicated facility designed to cut the time and cost of developing new robotic platforms.
